info.title: Attack on Titan: PATHS API
info.description: Read-only, spoiler-aware access to the PATHS knowledge graph. Every data endpoint takes `cutoff`, the last chapter the reader has read; nothing revealed after it is ever returned.

get.description: `world` orders events by when they happened (docs/model/dates.md §4); `story` orders them by the chapter that reveals them (docs/model/spoilers.md §8). Events whose date isn't revealed yet come last in world order.
